correctness.rationale: Multinomial enumeration in /workspace/replay.py (four_modes, Python 3 + SymPy) independently verifies the 11 Laurent terms for normalized c0=c1=1, the radical substitution, and the exact strict nine-grid witness. In RESULT.md §§2–4 the paired cosines reduce to 112+288t²+12t(11+4t²)cos η. The minimum over η at each |t| is attained, and the strictly convex cubic in |t| has its sole interior minimizer at 2−√111/6. There |t| is nonzero, so η is locked modulo π and gives β=3α modulo 2π and cos α=−|t|. The second-difference phase distinguishes the two remaining orbits. Parseval on the probability-normalized circle and roots of unity gives exact quadrature at all N≥10 because deg(P³)=9; the only extra terms at N=9 are the endpoint lags ±9. The exact formula is correct; its decimal expansion is 96.2410815259315501…, differing from the printed decimal in the last few digits. No assertion is needed about N<9. The packaged checker was inspected, not executed.
